author: Techlore
description:
F-Droid 2.0 is the biggest update to the FOSS Android app store in a decade. I walk through the redesign, the new search + filters, install prompts that finally come *before* the download (thanks, EU DMA!), automatic updates, Tor VPN, signer info, adding third-party repos, and more!

Thank you to Cake Wallet for sponsoring this video! Cake Wallet is a free, open-source, wallet where you own your keys, not a bank or third party. Plus Cake Pay so you can spend crypto on everyday things in the real world. Download it for free now: https://cakewallet.com/install
